subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: When given a search query, the reading room shall return matches across the corpus with document, heading/anchor context, and open-at-match navigation; a query matching an anchor-ID grammar shall rank its exact matches first.
rationale: search is the index humans lack; IDs are the corpus's native names
fit_criterion: fixture queries: free-text hits carry doc + context and open at the match; ID queries land their defining row first; a no-hit query returns an explicit empty state
